sources.entry: Board For GitHub - Small application to monitor your GitHub project web page in a native macOS app :octocat:!

summary.one_liner: A small native macOS app that displays a GitHub project web page in its own window so you can monitor it.
summary.what_it_does: Board For GitHub is a lightweight macOS application that loads a GitHub project page into a native window. On first launch it redirects to the GitHub login page and shows a default project. The user clicks the octocat icon in the upper-left of the window, enters a project URL in a dialog, and the app loads that page. The URL is saved in UserDefaults so the app opens the same project automatically next time. The README describes it only as a monitoring window for a GitHub project page and gives no further feature list.
use_cases: keep a GitHub project board open on the desktop
monitor a GitHub project page in a separate window
view a GitHub project without a browser tab
how_to_run: Download the app from the Releases page linked in the README
notable: Opens a GitHub project page in a native macOS window
Remembers the last project URL in UserDefaults
Project URL is set via the octocat icon in the window toolbar
caveats: README states system requirement of macOS 10.12; older versions (10.10, 10.11) are uncertain
Requires logging in to GitHub on first launch
License not stated in the README
